static_traits.name: Wang Dan
static_traits.social_status: has several close friends but has not yet opened up to them; after the rejection, tending toward Social withdrawal due to Low sense of self-worth,Interpersonal relationships affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems in the past, and never received psychotherapy/counseling
static_traits.language_features: clear expression,Good logic, able to accurately describe automatic thoughts and feelings; willing to cooperate in exploration and try small steps; mood leaning anxious and low but responsive to Guidance, with some self-Reflection capacity

basic_info.main_problem: after the Manuscript rejected by the publisher, intense worthlessness and Self-doubt emerged, believing oneself not good at writing and that one should give it up completely, accompanied by catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mind-reading and 'black-and-white' thinking; whenever thinking of writing or preparing to start a new project, feeling Depression and paralysis, gradually avoiding writing and growing distant from friends.
basic_info.core_demands: 'The rejection of the manuscript severely affected my self-esteem and my passion for writing (which is crucial to my well-being)', I hope through counseling to cope with self-doubt, correct negative thinking, and restore writing motivation and confidence.
growth_experiences: a few months ago, the Manuscript rejected by the publisher that Wang Dan had poured great effort into creating. The rejection was very stressful at the time, and intense worthlessness and Self-doubt began to emerge afterward. She gradually formed the belief that 'one rejection means never succeeding', believing she is not good at writing and should give up; whenever thinking of writing or trying to start a new project, the thought 'I will just be rejected again anyway' surges up and she falls into action paralysis. During this time she tried finding other interests to Displacement attention, but the worthlessness persisted; interest and Decreased motivation in daily life, actively keeping distance from friends due to feeling like a failure, and not yet revealing her feelings and troubles to friends.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/have no talent
I am doomed to never succeed (one failure proves I am not capable)

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if rejected once, it means I have no writing talent,I am not good enough;Being rejected equals being a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: deciding to give up writing, Displacement to other hobbies to avoid being frustrated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not capable anymore, should give up writing forever

special_situations.event: Sits down to prepare to write, or as soon as he thinks of starting a new project
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I write again, I will still be Being rejected/mocked; only being accepted by a publisher counts as valuable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: procrastinating, avoiding writing tasks, sitting still without moving but not starting to write
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: What is the point? It will be returned anyway

special_situations.event: Friends give positive feedback or praise on her work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: others' praise is not reliable, friends are just comforting me out of politeness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negating positive feedback, only seizing on negative evidence like rejections to prove I am not capable
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, not genuinely liking it

special_situations.event: Imagines how editors/readers will evaluate her work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if others do not like it, it provesI am worthless; external evaluation determines my value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces showing his work and social contact to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They probably think I am ridiculous/terrible

core_conflict.wish: longing for one's creations to be seen and recognized, to be accepted and affirmed as a Writer
core_conflict.fear: fear of Being rejected, being mocked and negated, triggering shame and loss of self-worth
defense_goal: avoiding the hurt of being negated again through Withdrawal and keeping distance
preemptively belittling oneself, negating positive feedback to reduce the uncertainty and anxiety from external evaluation

object_relations.self_representation: a failed creator not worthy of recognition
object_relations.object_representation: harsh, negating and picky others (publishers/potential readers)
friends who seem friendly on the surface but are not sincere, possibly perfunctory

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or the counselor give positive feedback or encouragement
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: the client experiences the other as not sincere, merely polite (Projecting inner Self-denial onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: responding in a doubtful and negating tone, using the phrasing 'they are just being polite', downplaying or avoiding absorbing positive information.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to pick up writing again, try small-step actions, or focus on positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: appealing to the Interpretation that 'rejections are more real, praise is not reliable' to maintain existing beliefs, reducing emotional exposure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: stating in a calm, rationalized tone 'why not writing now is more appropriate / the probability of failure is greater', avoiding touching shame and vulnerability.

manifestations: asking oneself 'what is the point?' before writing, believing one will be Being rejected anyway
After manuscript rejection, loses the sense of purpose and value for the creation she once loved
outcomes: Writing motivation sharply declined, behavioral paralysis

manifestations: Keeping distance from friends because one feels oneself a failure
unwilling to confide in friends to avoid 'troubling others'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interprets friends' praise as 'just being polite', finding it hard to accept positive feedback
assuming Editor/readers will mock or negate one's work

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: unwilling to trouble friends, choosing to bear it alone, thus reducing help-seeking and sharing
Turning support needs that could have been expressed outward onto oneself instead, leading to isolation

when thinking 'I will trouble others/others will negate me'
